name: Celebrate
description: A confetti celebration for any occasion — a company anniversary, a birthday, a record month, a grand opening or a team win: a giant number, a headline, a message and a date line, in colours you choose.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: The short line above the headline. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: headline
params.label: Headline
params.help: Two lines are kept for it: about 24 characters fit. Longer headlines wrap to a third line and run into the message.

params.name: message
params.label: Message
params.help: A sentence or two under the headline; up to 200 characters fit. A line break starts a new line.
params.default: From two people in a garage to 140 colleagues in four cities. Thank you to every customer and teammate who got us here — cake in the kitchen at 15:00!

params.name: date_line
params.label: Date line
params.help: Plain text, typed the way you want it to read: a date, a time and place, or a sign-off.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Turn off if you have no logo.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A wide PNG or SVG with a transparent background (about 3.4 : 1 fills the box; other shapes are fitted inside it). Replace the Northwind placeholder.

params.name: big_text
params.label: Big number
params.help: The giant figure: years, a birthday, a percentage, a rank. Up to four characters; clear it for none.

params.name: big_label
params.label: Under the number
params.help: A word under the big number, such as YEARS or DAYS.
